title: Vultures over marble
text: Word spreads that a Great House teeters — debts, no clear heir, creditors circling. Ruin is a market like any other, and you have coin.

effects.tpl: You own a house's obligations now, which is nearly owning the house. They receive you standing. +18 prestige.

then.tpl: Your name joined to theirs saves their banners and raises yours. The city applauds the rescue. +25 prestige, +5 fame.

else.tpl: They spit on the offer and survive anyway — now with a grudge engraved. −8 prestige.

effects.tpl: You study exactly how a great house falls: slowly, then at the creditors' meeting. A free education in power.
